style: Original hand-painted collectible fantasy illustration set in Aethra, fractured arcane world held by luminous strands of the Vinculo. Painterly editorial fantasy, refined controlled oil/gouache brush texture, stylized realistic volume, crisp iconic silhouette, tactile weathered stone, brushed bronze, weighted layered textiles, imperfect crystals. Cinematic three-quarter key light, subtle magical bounce, high focal contrast, subdued low-detail backgrounds, atmospheric depth, readable at 150 pixels. Palette night ink #10182B, slate #263650, Vinculo violet #7154AD, fracture cyan #60C9D2, antique gold #D2AC6D, ivory #E9E4D9. No photorealism, anime or plastic 3D. VERTICAL 3:4, target 1536x2048. Single coherent scene, focal subject within central 60%, face/key object at 30-42% height; 10-12% safe perimeter; important gesture survives centered square crop. Full painted background, no artificial padding. NO text, letters, numbers, runes, typography, UI, card frames, icons, borders, watermarks, logos, prepainted UI gradients or recognizable franchise designs.

subjects.hero-centinela: Broad sturdy disciplined guardian with distinctive weathered middle-aged face, cropped dark hair and a short salt-and-pepper beard. Worn slate and bronze cuirass; huge shield of geological plates joined by delicate cyan strands. Firm triangular protective stance, shield and face centered, warm light across shield; eroded ramparts in mist. Mineral/bronze role palette.
subjects.hero-astral: Arcane researcher, older woman with distinctive angular face, brown skin, silver braided hair, layered heavy violet and ivory textile robe and handmade astronomical bracers. Listening intently to a small floating map made ONLY of curved stellar currents above one hand, no symbols. Precise restrained gesture, face and hand central; ancient observatory under fractured violet/cyan sky.
subjects.hero-sombra: Agile stealth tracker with distinctive young adult face, olive skin, short swept black hair; face partly lit and recognizable. Asymmetric patchwork indigo cloak, light armor, original practical exploration tools, moving diagonally between damp rocks and subtle turquoise Vinculo fissures. Central face and hands, stealth not combat, dynamic diagonal silhouette, subdued background.
subjects.great-convergence: Narrative epic tactical scene: three visible stone routes through an ancient valley converge upon a central weathered fortification. Multiple elegant violet and cyan Vinculo energy lines meet at its gate, antique gold pressure wave visibly buckles and breaks the defensive formation of tiny soldiers and raised stones. Pressure and rupture of formation, comprehensible physical action, no blinding cosmic explosion. Fortification gate focal at 40% height.
subjects.disrupt: Narrative sabotage scene: rival energy corridor, visible as a flowing cyan/violet luminous stream along an ancient stone route, bends and breaks into clearly separated segments around a central cracked obelisk. Suspended dust and interrupted motion express sabotage of pressure. The broken obelisk and kink of the route occupy central 60%; restrained luminous edges, tangible stones, no holographic UI.
subjects.line-guard: Narrative defensive scene: translucent protective curved barrier and overlapping ethereal mineral-glass shields shelter a threatened stone route and several small cloaked defenders, grounded physically in the path, not floating logo. Incoming fragments deflect visibly from the barrier. Soft cyan light reflected on weathered stone and heavy textiles, restrained antique bronze, central barrier focal 40% height, readable protective silhouette.
